verdict.rationale: The only multi-item evidence is fleet management: locations and zones streamline managing multiple readers across sites, and readers can be registered by order number. Beyond that, the API, CLI and MCP server only make scripted, item-by-item automation possible; no native bulk endpoint or batch action is documented. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch operations (e.g., batch reader configuration, bulk refunds or updates), documentation of multi-item actions in API/CLI/MCP, and hands-on corroboration.
